blocks.html: “Got to Believe in Magic”, “Hold On”, “Heart of Mine”, “Set You Free”—familiar songs that so tugged our hearts in the 90s by no less than charismatic Joey G. Well, the Gen Xers can get to catch him singing live at Robinsons Magnolia on Saturday, February 15 at the Mall’s Atrium.

The former front man of Side A, an iconic band of the 90s, Joey G has kept himself busy doing the concert rounds with various OPM artists. This Robinsons Magnolia stint will give shoppers and mallers a chance to hear his music once again.
For more information, check our Robinsons Magnolia in Facebook and IG.
